docs.title: *The unified platform* for infrastructure teams.
docs.snippet: Infrastructure as code with modern languages, centralized secrets and governance, and AI built for infrastructure — all in one platform. Everything teams need to move fast and scale with confidence.

docs.title: Open source foundation, enterprise scale
docs.snippet: Compose your infrastructure code with the languages and tools your team already uses — TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, or Java. Our Apache 2.0-licensed engine gives you a foundation to scale from small project to large organization.

docs.title: Meet Neo, your AI platform engineer
docs.heading_path: Meet Neo, your AI platform engineer
docs.snippet: Pulumi works with the coding agents your team already uses — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more. Neo is the industry's first AI agent purpose-built for infrastructure: it handles complex tasks, debugs deployments, and generates code for new and existing cloud resources.

docs.title: One interface for all your secrets and config
docs.heading_path: One interface for all your secrets and config
docs.snippet: Pulumi ESC brings secrets and configuration from every major vault and cloud provider into a single interface. Use it with Pulumi IaC or on its own.

docs.title: See everything, control everything
docs.snippet: Search across all clouds from a single pane of glass in Pulumi Cloud. Enforce policies automatically, track compliance, and get AI-powered insights. Know exactly what's running where and why.

docs.title: Enable self-service infrastructure at scale
docs.snippet: Give your engineers the ability to provision infrastructure through templates, components, and developer portals, while platform teams maintain control through guardrails and governance.

docs.title: Get started in 5 minutes
docs.heading_path: Enable self-service infrastructure at scale > Get started in 5 minutes
docs.snippet: Get started in 5 minutes Deploy your first infrastructure with Pulumi. Choose your language, pick your cloud, ship your code.

docs.title: Migrating to Pulumi?
docs.heading_path: Enable self-service infrastructure at scale > Migrating to Pulumi?
docs.snippet: Migrating to Pulumi? Our tools can help you migrate your code and resource state from Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Azure Resource Manager, and others to Pulumi. Use Neo to make the process even easier.
